title: fix(metadata-admin): align state_machine validation rule with ADR-0020; retire workflow designer
body:
## Summary

Brings the frontend metadata designer in sync with backend **ADR-0020** (merged in framework #1413), which retired `workflow` as a metadata type and converged record state machines onto a single `state_machine` **validation rule** with a flat shape: `{ field, transitions: Record<string, string[]> }` (no `stateField`, no `Array<{from,to,condition}>`, no guards).

## 🔴 BREAK fixes — `state_machine` rule now uses the new shape

| File | Fix |
|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` | `StateMachineValidation`: `stateField`→`field`, `Array<{from,to}>`→`Record<string,string[]>` |
| `packages/core/.../object-validation-engine.ts` | Rewrote `validateStateMachine` to the Record shape with server-matching semantics (insert→allow, unchanged field→allow, undeclared from-state→lenient allow, `to ∉ transitions[from]`→reject). The old `for…of` over a Record **threw at runtime** |
| `packages/app-shell/.../previews/ValidationPreview.tsx` | Renders the `{from: [to,…]}` map (was reading the old array shape and silently showing "No transitions declared") |
| `packages/core/.../object-validation-engine.test.ts` | Rewrote engine state_machine cases to the new shape; replaced the removed conditional-transition case with insert / no-op / lenient-from cases |

## 🟡 STALE cleanup — orphaned `workflow` metadata-type designer

The server no longer serves the `workflow` type, so these were dead registrations:
- removed `WorkflowPreview` + `WorkflowActionInspector` and their registrations
- dropped the `workflow` clientValidation loader, anchors entry, and i18n labels

## Out of scope (intentionally untouched)
- `@object-ui/plugin-workflow` — a standalone BPMN/process-designer component, unrelated to the backend metadata type
- the workflow RPC service surface

## Verification
- `@object-ui/core` validation tests: **21/21 pass**
- `metadata-admin` suite: **46/46 pass**
- `tsc --noEmit` clean on `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/app-shell`
